theorems.statement: ∀ {n ℓ : ℕ} (G : Rn n → Amb n ℓ) (c : Rn n) (ρ κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ n → ContDiff ℝ 1 G → 0 < κ → (∀ v ∈ ball c ρ, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ G v)) → (∀ v ∈ ball c ρ, ∀ w ∈ ball c ρ, κ * ‖v - w‖ ≤ ‖G v - G w‖) → MeasurableSet (G '' ball c ρ) ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (G '' ball c ρ) < ⊤ ∧ ∃ T : Amb n ℓ → Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ), ContinuousOn (fun x => (T x).starProjection) (G '' ball c ρ) ∧ ∀ x ∈ G '' ball c ρ, Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (G '' ball c ρ) x (T x)
